scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('public', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.test:postgres: node --no-warnings -e "if(!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL)throw Error('Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a disposable PostgreSQL database');process.env.TEST_POSTGRES='1';require('./test.js')"
